purpose: Observed modeling guidance; not approval or PT acceptance.
method: Direct visual inspection of the three actual photos and their corresponding native massa/ohje images. No silhouette masks or IoU artifacts consulted for this review.

findings.observation: The distant palace range and its terminal right pavilion are visibly higher in the generated frame than in the source. The near-right facade footline remains substantially closer, so the projected depth is stretched rather than the whole image simply translated.
findings.modelingGuidance: Retain the native source roofline and camera projection; do not raise or deepen the distant range to follow this photograph.

findings.observation: The left enclosed Cour Carree roofline and courtyard opening sit higher than in the source, and the visible opening is vertically compressed.
findings.modelingGuidance: Use the source courtyard opening and surrounding mass boundaries.

findings.observation: The far background is filled by city blocks, a boulevard and gardens; no river is depicted. A pale round pool/basin is visible at the extreme upper-right.
findings.modelingGuidance: Do not copy this painted background or the added basin into mapped geography.

views.poolsObserved: Round pool/basin cropped by the extreme upper-right edge.
views.photographicSurfaceQuality: Convincing limestone, slate roofs, paving, tree detail and daylight at native full-frame inspection.

findings.observation: The palace is pulled substantially upward. The far range is much higher than its source roofline, and the foreground facade footline is also higher; the courtyard projection is vertically expanded and much more foreground river is exposed. This does not preserve the supplied camera/framing.
findings.modelingGuidance: Keep the source screen-space mass placement, depth and foreground crop; do not shift the modeled palace upward or alter the camera to match this photograph.

findings.observation: An equestrian statue is inserted into the enclosed right-hand courtyard. That placement is an added photographic detail rather than a feature established by the supplied mass/guide.
findings.modelingGuidance: Do not derive statue placement from this generated photograph.

views.environmentObservation: The river is on the near side, the main open court is left and the enclosed court is right. The dominant visible error is the displaced palace framing.
views.photographicSurfaceQuality: Stone, roof material, paving, river surface and illumination read photographically at full frame; the major defect is mass placement.

findings.observation: A conspicuous circular planted feature with a rectangular center has been inserted into the otherwise open far courtyard.
findings.modelingGuidance: Keep the source courtyard empty at this location; do not model this invented feature.

findings.observation: The left-side river makes a pronounced inward turn behind the far-left wing instead of reading as a continuous longitudinal corridor beside the palace.
findings.modelingGuidance: Do not trace this generated river course into mapped geography.

views.cameraAndMassObservation: The principal framing, distant terminal masses, center pavilion and large cropped foreground wings follow the supplied massa/ohje closely in this visual comparison.
views.poolsObserved: No definite courtyard pool observed; the added central circular feature reads as planting.
views.photographicSurfaceQuality: Credible limestone, roof surfaces, courtyard paving and coherent daylight; material appearance is useful independently of the added ground features.
